verdict.rationale: Teams itself is a collaboration app, not something you 'run headlessly,' but its automation surface (Graph API, Agents Toolkit CLI, webhooks/bots) lets AI-native users script and automate Teams workflows in CI-like fashion. Evidence shows a documented CLI (Agents Toolkit CLI) for scaffolding/provisioning/deploying, plus a live, machine-readable Graph API for messaging automation outside the client UI. missing for 10: no evidence of a true headless/CI execution mode for the client itself, no CI pipeline examples/integration guides, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of automation reliability at scale.
